attributes.name: Bluesky early adoption Q1Q2 2023
attributes.description: Early user and posts growth of Bluesky, as exposed through the AT Protocol APIs.
attributes.rich_description:
Chart showing daily users and posts statistics as extracted from the [Bluesky data dump](https://worthdoingbadly.com/bsky/) as published by [Zhuowei Zhang](https://twitter.com/zhuowei) on his beforelinked blog post.

Dataset includes posts until May 1st, 2023.
